blocks.raw: <Warn>A common exam trap: confusing **administrative supervision** (PRC handles budget, staff, facilities — organizational support) with **operational control** (PRBoA decides professional standards, exam content, discipline — professional autonomy). The PRC cannot order the Board to change exam standards or shield a violator. If an answer choice suggests the PRC can control Board professional judgments, it is wrong.</Warn>

blocks.raw: <Tip>The three-tier appeal path is: **Board (first instance)** → **Commission (appeal)** → **Court of Appeals (judicial review)**. The Commission does not retry the case — it reviews the Board's record for legal error, abuse of discretion, or insufficient evidence. The Court applies the arbitrary-and-capricious standard. Know this hierarchy cold for the LEA.</Tip>
